cases.sentence: Между прислугой дома в это же время происходило ___.
cases.explain: «сильное волнение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Among the servants of the household there was intense excitement all this time. All had heard that their mistress had come, and that Kapitonitch had let her in, and that she was even now in the nursery, and that their master always went in person to the nursery at nine o’clock, and everyone fully comprehended that it was impossible for the husband and wife to meet, and that they must prevent it. Korney, the valet, going down to the hall-porter’s room, asked who had let her in, and how it was he had done so, and ascertaining that Kapitonitch had admitted her and shown her up, he gave the old man a talking-to. The hall-porter was doggedly silent, but when Korney told him he ought to be sent away, Kapitonitch darted up to him, and waving his hands in Korney’s face, began:

cases.sentence: Ты бы про себя помнил, как барина обирать да ___ таскать!
cases.explain: «енотовые шубы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Oh yes, to be sure you’d not have let her in! After ten years’ service, and never a word but of kindness, and there you’d up and say, ‘Be off, go along, get away with you!’ Oh yes, you’re a shrewd one at politics, I dare say! You don’t need to be taught how to swindle the master, and to filch fur coats!”

cases.sentence: Сережа, сияя глазами и улыбкой и держась одною рукой за мать, другою за няню, топотал по ковру жирными ___.
cases.explain: «голыми ножками» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Seryozha, with radiant eyes and smiles, holding his mother by one hand and his nurse by the other, pattered on the rug with his fat little bare feet. The tenderness shown by his beloved nurse to his mother threw him into an ecstasy.

cases.sentence: Нежность ___ к матери приводила его в восхищенье.
cases.explain: «любимой няни» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Seryozha, with radiant eyes and smiles, holding his mother by one hand and his nurse by the other, pattered on the rug with his fat little bare feet. The tenderness shown by his beloved nurse to his mother threw him into an ecstasy.

cases.sentence: Мать отстранила его от себя, чтобы понять, то ли он думает, что говорит, и в ___ его лица она прочла, что он не только говорил об отце, но как бы спрашивал ее, как ему надо об отце думать.
cases.explain: «испуганном выражении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The mother held him away from her to see what he was thinking, what to say to him, and in his frightened face she read not only that he was speaking of his father, but, as it were, asking her what he ought to think about his father.

cases.sentence: Она ___ опустила вуаль и, прибавив шагу, почти выбежала из комнаты.
cases.explain: «быстрым движением» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Although she had just said he was better and kinder than she, in the rapid glance she flung at him, taking in his whole figure in all its details, feelings of repulsion and hatred for him and jealousy over her son took possession of her. With a swift gesture she put down her veil, and, quickening her pace, almost ran out of the room.
